onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: Empowering neighborhoods with rapid early warnings and community hazard reporting
onboarding.permissionsSubtitle: We respect your privacy and only request what is needed to verify hazards:
onboarding.locationPermDesc: Pinpoints exact flood hazard coordinates for rescue workers. If denied, you can still select coordinates manually on the map.
onboarding.cameraPermDesc: Allows you to capture flood water depth and embankment damage. If denied, you can still submit reports without photos.
onboarding.notificationPermDesc: Receives critical flash flood warnings and updates when responders review your report.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyDesc: This app collects only the minimum data required to triage flood hazards: location coordinates, optional photos, and optional contact info.
settings.deleteConfirm: This will clear all saved offline reports, cached alerts, and preferences from this device.
